samples.summary: Lessons doc cites the wrong line number for the 'nf: number with no dp renders 2 decimals' claim.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260818-sheets-decimal-round-trip-lessons.md states: "nf: 'number' with no dp renders 2 decimals (formatValue, packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/format.ts:119)." Line 119 in that file is inside safeFormatDate (date-of-month padding), unrelated to formatValue's decimal-place default. The actual logic (clampDecimals(dp, 2) and the 'number' case) lives around lines 213-224 of the same file. The behavioral claim itself is correct, but the citation would mislead a reader trying to verify it.
